overview: A full-stack Goal Setting & Tracking Portal for ATOMQUEST HACKATHON 1.0. Supports the complete goal lifecycle — from employee goal creation and manager approval, through quarterly check-ins and achievement tracking, to admin reporting and audit trails. Three role-based dashboards for Employee, Manager, and Admin/HR with instant demo role-switching for evaluators.
features: Employee goal sheet with Thrust Area, UoM, targets, and weightage validation (100% total, 10% min, 8 max)
Manager approval workflow with inline editing and goal locking on approval
Shared Goals pushed by Admin/Manager synced across linked employee sheets
Quarterly check-in interface with Planned vs Actual tracking
Progress score formulas for Min, Max, Timeline, and Zero UoM types
Manager check-in comments and structured feedback logs
Admin achievement report with CSV export
Field-level audit trail for all post-lock changes
Analytics: QoQ trends, goal distribution, manager effectiveness
Instant demo role-switcher on landing page with pre-seeded demo users
